summary: [standards] `canon schema evidence approval-payload` still declares only COMMIT_REQUIRED, CONFIG_*, EVIDENCE_ARGUMENT_INVALID/REQUIRED, EVIDENCE_REQUIRED, SCENARIO_INDEX_REQUIRED, SPEC_ROOT_NOT_FOUND, WRITE_FAILED (plus globals), while the fixed call now answers TASK_NOT_FOUND, PLAN_SOURCES_REQUIRED and the plan document codes (driven: `evidence approval-payload --task c1#1` -> TASK_NOT_FOUND / PLAN_SOURCES_REQUIRED) and `repo_error` codes. The table is derived by a source scan that cannot see `error.to_cli_error()` of `dispatch::validate_task_binding`; `evidence add` has the same gap (TASK_NOT_FOUND undeclared, TASK_EVIDENCE_INVALID declared). Pre-existing limit of the scan, the fix did not widen it for the new path. An agent reading `canon schema` is not told the code the scenario names.
